veinminer.name: Veinminer
veinminer.tagline: Sneak, mine one ore, and the whole vein comes out.
veinminer.note.server: On a server, the server's own settings apply. Operators use /veinminer set.
veinminer.setting.require_sneak.desc: Veins only start while you sneak. Off: every block you mine starts one.
veinminer.setting.max_blocks.desc: The most blocks one vein mines, the one you struck included.
veinminer.setting.diagonal.desc: Veins also run through blocks that only touch at an edge or corner.
veinminer.setting.durability.desc: Every extra block wears your tool. A vein never breaks it. Off: veins are free.
veinminer.setting.animation.desc: The vein pops block by block. Off: it all breaks at once.
veinminer.setting.drops.desc: In front: the loot drops where the ore was. At your feet: all of it drops by you.
veinminer.setting.feedback.desc: A short message above the hotbar when a vein ends.
veinminer.desc.earth: Mine a whole patch of %s at once with any shovel.
veinminer.desc.ore: Mine the whole vein of %s at once.
veinminer.desc.custom.tag: Mine connected blocks of this tag at once with the right tool.
veinminer.desc.custom.block: Mine a whole patch of %s at once with the right tool.
veinminer.setting.pick_blocks.desc: Pick any block, or a block tag, to mine as a vein.
veinminer.preview.off.chain: Chain is off: all at once
veinminer.preview.off.sneak: Sneak is off: any block veins
veinminer.preview.off.wear: Wear is off: one point total
veinminer.preview.off.loot: Chain is off: loot stays put
veinminer.preset.small.note: Shorter veins, the rest stays standing
veinminer.preset.everything.note: Dirt, sand, gravel and clay vein too
veinminer.preset.instant.note: The whole vein breaks at once
